mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) signals a strengthening consumer demand environment that boosts corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of rising GDPC1 are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) signals weakening manufacturing output that reduces corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of falling INDPRO are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a weakening labor market that reduces corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of rising UNRATE are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above a 0.5% threshold signals a strengthening consumer demand environment that boosts corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of GDPC1 rising > 0.5% are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the industrial production index (INDPRO) below a 0.5% threshold signals weakening manufacturing output that reduces corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of INDPRO falling < -0.5% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) above a 4.5% threshold signals a tightening monetary cycle that increases discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of FEDFUNDS > 4.5% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above a 0.3% threshold signals a weakening labor market that reduces corporate earnings growth, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns in periods of UNRATE rising > 0.3% are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).
